claim_text: Average peak-period trip duration for Alderwick residents was 22 minutes in 2022.
source_text: 2022 Mobility Monitoring Report — Alderwick. The summary states that average peak-period trip duration was 22 minutes. Table 6, using the same measure—the mean door-to-door duration for trips beginning between 7:00 and 9:00 a.m., all modes combined—reports 26.7 minutes for Alderwick residents. The report notes that both figures cover the same survey wave.
evidence_quote: Table 6, using the same measure—the mean door-to-door duration for trips beginning between 7:00 and 9:00 a.m., all modes combined—reports 26.7 minutes for Alderwick residents.
metric_definition: Mean door-to-door duration for trips beginning between 7:00 and 9:00 a.m., all modes combined.
verification_rationale: The table reports 26.7 minutes for the same measure, population, and survey wave, which conflicts with the claim's value of 22 minutes.
